[[Category:Glasgow Name Study]]

== Biography ==
'''James Glasgow''' was born on 9 November 1808, a son of [[Glasgow-822|John Glasgow]] and [[Arthur-2480|Mary Arthur]]. John and Mary's family register records James among their nine children.<ref name="GlasgowBible">Glasgow family Bible, family register of [[Glasgow-822|John Glasgow]] and [[Arthur-2480|Mary Arthur]], [https://hiltner.com/mckeown/histories/8479.jpeg original register image]; [https://hiltner.com/mckeown/showmedia.php?mediaID=532&medialinkID=726 media description], ''McKeown and Shields Families''; the collection is indexed at [https://hiltner.com/mckeown/index.php hiltner.com/mckeown], accessed 29 August 2026.</ref>

The same register records that James died after a sudden illness on 20 April 1823. It does not state his place of death.<ref name="GlasgowBible" />

== Research Notes ==
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-822]] is assessed at 99% (proved). The family-register photograph explicitly begins with John Glasgow and Mary Arthur’s marriage and lists James born 9 November 1808 among their children. It also records his death on 20 April 1823, separating him from later James probate entries.

Confident for this register-defined child and father. The handwritten family page was visually checked in this batch; its authorship and exact entry dates are not established.

Next useful test: Preserve the register’s 1823 death boundary in any future James probate comparison.

Source basis already held: [https://hiltner.com/mckeown/histories/8479.jpeg Glasgow family Bible, family register of John Glasgow and Mary Arthur, original register image (https://hiltner.com/mckeown/histories/8479.jpeg); media description (https://hiltner.com/mckeown/showmedia.php?mediaID=532&medialinkID=726), McKeown and Shields Families; the collection is indexed at hiltner.com/mckeown (https://hiltner.com/mckeown/index.php), accessed 29 August 2026.]. No new father attached; cited evidence and any inspected register entry are scoped above.


=== Oritor and Killycurragh probate exclusions ===
A 1826 administration-bond index names James Glasgow, gentleman, of Oritor.<ref name="Oritor1826">Public Record Office of Northern Ireland, [https://apps.proni.gov.uk/ProniNames_IE/SearchPage.aspx Names Search], result for James Glasgow, gentleman, Oritor, 1826 administration bond, accessed 29 August 2026.</ref> A separate 1836 probate entry names James Glasgow of Killycurragh.<ref name="Killycurragh1836">Public Record Office of Northern Ireland, [https://apps.proni.gov.uk/ProniNames_IE/SearchPage.aspx Names Search], result for James Glasgow, Killycurragh, 1836, accessed 29 August 2026.</ref> Neither record can belong to this James because the family register establishes that he died in 1823. They should remain separate unidentified estates.
